bootstrap.intro: Okokuqala, lungisa idatha-bhase. Emva kwalokho uzokhetha ukuthi uqale umhlaba omusha noma ujoyine i-mesh esikhona — futhi, uma uqala kabusha, dala i-akhawunti yakho yophathi.
bootstrap.schema_fresh: Idatha-bhase entsha — isikhizo esiphelele sifakwa ngesinyathelo esisodwa.
join_host.already_connected: Usuxhumene nomphathi — lokhu kuqhubeka nokuvumelanisa lapho kwashiyeka khona (alidingeki i-URL yomphathi).
join_host.approval_body: Kubhokisi lomphathi: ngena ku-operator plane yawo, vula {link} → Host adoption console → Pending adoption requests → Approve. Emva kwalokho buyela lapha bese uthumela futhi — ukuvumelanisa kuqala.
join_host.discover_help: Ihlola isango lomphakathi, futhi — uma uvuma — isikena inethiwekhi yakho yasendaweni. Alidingeki ikheli.
join_host.heading: Joyina i-mesh esikhona
join_host.intro: Xhuma le nodi kumfelandawonye osebenza kakade. Kuvumelanisa yonke imidlalo — isisekelo semaphu, umthethosisekelo, nezikhungo — futhi iba ikhophi yesibuko efundeka kuphela. Akukho ukwakha izikhungo: udlala umdlalo ofanayo nabanye abase-mesh.
join_host.join_key_optional: (akudingeki — shiya isikhala ukuze ucele ukuvunyelwa uphathi)
join_host.none_found: Awutholwa umfelandawonye. Faka i-URL yomphathi phansi, noma hlola inethiwekhi yakho uzame futhi.
join_host.syncing_body: Kuxhunywe — kuthathwa imibhalo ngemuva. Inqubo ibonakala phansi; lokhu kuphela ngokwakho (futhi kuqhubeka uma kuphazamiseka). Ungashiya le khasi.
mode_fork.footer: Lokhu kukhetha kwenziwa kanye kuphela empilweni yale instance. Ukuyidala kabusha kusebenzisa docker compose down -v.
mode_fork.heading: Le node kufanele ijoyine kanjani lo mdlalo?
mode_fork.intro: I-akhawunti yakho yomphathi isilungiswe. Yonke i-node kumele idlale lo mdlalo ofanayo — ngakho umbuzo owodwa ukuthi le node iqala umhlaba noma ijoyina lowo osekhona.
mode_fork.join_body: Xhumana nomphathi osekuphakathi komfelandawonye. Konke kuhlangana — isisekelo semaphu, umthethosisekelo, nezikhungo zonke — futhi le node iba ikhophi yesibuko yokufunda kuphela. Akukho ukwakha izikhungo; udlala lo mdlalo ofanayo nabanye.
mode_fork.solo_body: Yakha lo mdlalo lapha — bhala umthethosisekelo, faka imaphu, dweba izifunda, hlala ezikhungweni. Uba ngumdlalo oyinhloko, futhi amanye ama-node ahlangana nawe. Kunalulelwa i-node yokuqala kumfelandawonye.
operator_setup.account_claimed: I-akhawunti ithathwe. Ukuxhuma ubuwena be-mesh nge-device key kuse khasi le-Identity.
operator_setup.channels_intro: Izinhamba phansi kwamakhadi ezindima — vula noma iyiphi ngokwakha, bese uqedela ukusetha kwengqalasizinda lapho inhamba idingeka khona.
operator_setup.channels_locked: Izindima zitholakala lapho i-akhawunti yomphathi engenhla isendayiwe.
operator_setup.full_console: Ukhetha ikhansoli ephelele? Vula ikhansoli yophathi →
operator_setup.heading: Lungisa i-node yakho
operator_setup.intro: Izinyathelo ezinhlanu: thola i-akhawunti yakho, nikela igama lenkinga, khetha umsebenzi, qedela ukulungisa, bese usulungele. Unguphathi omelele, ngakho wonke umsebenzi ungawuvula ngqo.
operator_setup.localhost_warning: — i-localhost isebenza kule khompyutha kuphela; sebenzisa ikheli lakho le-LAN/lomphakathi ukuze uthole abanye abasebenzisi.
operator_setup.needs_setup_note: Ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo kuzolandela — ungavula umsebenzi manje bese uqedela ukulungiswa kwakhe lapho.
operator_setup.needs_setup_title: Ezinye izisebenzi zisadinga ukulungiswa ngaphambi kokuba zisebenze:
operator_setup.path_a: Indlela A — i-akhawunti entsha yasendaweni. Izimfihlo zakho zophathi; iphasiwedi isebenza kule bhokisi kuphela.
operator_setup.path_b_body: Usuyuphathi kwenye indawo kwi-mesh? Ungazibona kwamanye amabhokisi ngokuba ne-device-key — ikhi elithenjwa ukuzibona kwakho lisayina ubufakazi kanye kuphela; ayikho iphasiwedi ephindwa phakathi kwamabhokisi. Kule bhokisi: thola i-akhawunti ngenhla kuqala, bese uxhumana nokuzibona kwe-mesh ku Identity → devices — i-Ed25519 public key kuphela eyibhalisa; imfihlo ayiphumi neze kudivayisi yakho.
operator_setup.path_b_title: Indlela B — xhuma nokuzibona kwe-mesh esikhona
operator_setup.reach_open_body: Beka ikheli abanye abasebenzisi abalisebenzisa ukuze bafinyelele kule bhokisi.
operator_setup.reach_question: Ubani okufanele akwazi ukufinyelela kule node?
operator_setup.reach_solo_body: Isebenza kule khompyutha. Alikho ikheli elidingekayo — ungayivulela abanye kamuva lapho usulungele ukwamukela abanye abasebenzisi.
operator_setup.restart_required: Ikheli lishintshile. Phinda usebenze umyalelo wokuqala (docker compose up -d) ukuze ama-container alithole ngaphambi kokuba abanye abasebenzisi bahlanganyele.
operator_setup.role_archivist_consent: Okulawulwayo — ekusungulweni uzizibekela wena; izinguquko zakamuva zidlula ngokuvuma kwabo bonke.
operator_setup.role_archivist_duty: Nikezela i-app uqobo lwayo — isikhathi sokusebenza ne-bandwidth kubantu bangempela.
operator_setup.role_archivist_what: I-peer ephelele enikezela abasebenzisi be-browser i-application yonke.
operator_setup.role_identity_broker_cons: Okulawulwayo — imingcele enzima: ama-peer athintekayo avuma izinguquko zakamuva.
operator_setup.role_identity_broker_duty: Bamba i-DNS token evaliwe; nikeza amagama nezitifiketi kuma-peer.
operator_setup.role_identity_broker_what: Amagama angempela nezitifiketi ze-mesh nodes — umsebenzi onzima kakhulu.
operator_setup.role_intro: Umsebenzi ukuwuhlanganyiso lokulungele kwama-capability channels — akukho amandla amasha. Imisebenzi yizibopho zezinhlelo, hhayi amalungelo omvoti (awuthengi ukuvota noma isihlalo). Njenguphathi omelele uzizibekela ngqo; lapho kuhleliwe uhulumeni, imisebenzi elawulwayo ibuyela ekuvumelwaneni kwabo bonke izinguquko zakamuva.
operator_setup.role_record_keeper_consen: Okuzibekelwe — ukuchofoza kanye. Inketho yakho yezinhlelo.
operator_setup.role_record_keeper_duty: Gcina ibhokisi lakho livuliwe futhi lihambisana; nikezela irekhodi elihlanganyelwe kubantu.
operator_setup.role_record_keeper_what: Yenza ikhophi yesibuko yirekhodi lomphakathi futhi ugcine idatha yendawo yomhlaba iqhubeke nokuhamba.
operator_setup.role_social_moderator_con: Kubuseka — ekusungulweni uzizibekela; izinguquko ezilandela zidlula ngokuvuma okuhlanganyelwe.
operator_setup.role_social_moderator_dut: 运行 iserba yasendlini kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana zokuxhumana zomphakathi.
operator_setup.role_social_moderator_wha: Hlinzekela amaqhinga aqhuba khona — ingxoxo, izwi, nezindawo azisebenzela.
operator_setup.share_intro: Nikeza osebenza naye isikripithi sokuqala senye ifayela. Solo = bathola umhlaba wabo; Join = benza ikhophi yesibuko yalo (kudingeka ikheli lenode lakho libekwe ngenhla).
operator_setup.share_join_warning: Beka ikheli lenode elingafinyeleleka ngenhla kuqala, ngoba isikripithi sokujoyina ngeke yazi ukuthi ikhona kuphi.
setup_exportbackuppanel.build_a_portable: Yenza isithombe esithuthukile se-.tar.gz salolu hlelo — yonke ithebula eliyingxenye ye-FK-downstream graph yezindawo zegunya, kanye nezilungiselelo nama-raster. Ukubuyisela lolu hlelo kwenye indawo ngokusebenzisa i-Restore from a backup panel yeSinyathelo 0 kubuyisela isimo sonke, kuhlanganise namamephu ezifunda. Isebenza ngokuzimela nge-Horizon; ukukhipha okukhulu (ama-raster aphelele) kuthatha imizuzu engama-20–40.
setup_importbackuppanel.already_have_a_t: Usunayo i-.tar.gz ekhiphwe kwenye indawo? I-upload-e lapha ukuze ushaye phambili. I-backend ihlola ishejini ye-manifest ngaphambi kokubuyisela — izithombe ezindala zenyukwa ngomyalezo ocacile. Ngemuva kokubuyisela okuphumelelayo uzofika kunoma isiphi isinyathelo se-wizard esihambisana nenqubekela egcinwe kule bundle (ngakho i-backup ethathwe eSinyathelo 3 ikubuyisela eSinyathelo 3).
setup_importbackuppanel.only_tables_actu: Amathebula akhona ngempela ku-bundle e-upload-weyo kuphela yilapho abuyiselwayo — amathebula angakhethwa kulolu hlelo ayashiywa.
setup_importbackuppanel.upload_complete_: I-upload iphelele — kubuyiselwa idatha (pg_restore). Kungathatha imizuzu embalwa ku-bundle lama-raster aphelele.
setup_jurisdictioncountsgrid.grand_total: Isizinda sobuningi bezinhlangano kuzo zonke izinga
setup_jurisdictioncountsgrid.populations: Ukubalwa kobuningi kwenzeka ngemuva kokuba ukulayisha i-raster kuqedile — lezi zibalo zihlala ku-0% kuze kube yilapho ama-tiles obuningi eqeda ukulayishwa kudatha.
setup_liveprogress.abort_the_entire_run_: Yema yonke inqubo. Kufana nokuchofoza uHalt.
setup_liveprogress.mark_this_country_as_: Maka leli lizwe njengelishiyiwe bese uya kokulandelayo.
setup_liveprogress.pause_the_etl_subproc: Yema isigaba se-ETL (SIGSTOP — ukuxhumana kwe-DB kuhlala kuvuliwe)
setup_liveprogress.re_run_this_country_u: Phinda ugize leli lizwe. Kusiza uma ulungisile inkinga (isib. ubuyisela ifayela elonakele).
setup_reviewissuessection.click_a_source: Chofoza umthombo ukuze ubone imigqa lapho abahlali baphuma khona:
setup_reviewissuessection.click_a_strate: Chofoza isu ukuze ubone imigqa exazululiwe ngaleyo ndlela:
setup_reviewissuessection.collapse_this_: Vala le khadi bese ukumaka njengokubuyekizwe kulesi sikhathi. Ukugcinwa kwakho kuseSigaba J.
setup_reviewissuessection.no_data_qualit: ✓ Azikho izinkinga zizinga ledatha ezitholwe. Kulungele ukuqeda ukusungula.
setup_rowdetailpanel.archive_not_visible: I-Archive ayibonakali ku-PHP — hlola ngomlomo phakathi kwe-etl container.
setup_rowdetailpanel.no_autofix_saving_r: Ayikho i-autofix — igcina irekhodi isinqumo sakho ukuze ubuyekeze noma uthole isixazululo kamuva.
setup_rowdetailpanel.no_spatial_overlap_: Akukho mkhethwa bokubambana kwendawo otholwe ezingeni eliphansi ne-ISO efanayo noma ubukhosi.
setup_rowdetailpanel.optional_note_what_: Inothi eliyinketho — yini oyinqumule futhi kungani?
setup_rowdetailpanel.siblings_under_with: Abazalwane ngaphansi kuka-{sovereign} abanobalo lwabantu elifanayo
step0_cosmic_address.accelerated_help: Isimulasyon ecindezelwe — khetha imizuzwana ngonyaka wesimulasyon.
step0_cosmic_address.instance_name_help: Ilabeli elijwayelekile lalolu kufakwa — libonakala ekunavigatheni nasezikhundleni zomfelandawonye.
step0_cosmic_address.intro: Lolu wuhlelo lwe-Cosmopolitan Governance App — inkundla evulekile yomfelandawonye esebenzisa A Fair Constitution. Lwakha zonke izikhungo ezichazwe yi-Template (ukuhlala, ukhetho, isishayamthetho, isigungu esiphethe, ubulungiswa, inhlangano) njengohlelo lwe-software olusebenzisekayo noluzenzakalayo, kusukela ezingeni lomakhelwane kuya ezingeni lomhlaba nangaphezulu.
step0_cosmic_address.real_time_help: Ukhetho ngesikhathi sangempela — ukujikeleza kweminyaka emi-5 ngokujwayelekile.
step0_cosmic_address.set_address: Masibeke ikheli lakho lezinkanyezi — isisekelo lapho i-instance yakho izohlanganisa khona.
step1_constants.autoseed_hint: Okujwayelekile: Umtshalo omfishane kakhulu · Uma indawo ithola izihlalo ezingaphezulu kwesilinganiso kodwa ingenazo izinhlukumezelo ezincane zokuqala, i-autoseeder ihlukanisa ubuholi bayo ngale ndlela. I-district mapper isengakwazi ukuchitha lokhu kuye ngokuhamba kohlelo.
step1_constants.autoseed_shortest: Umtshalo omfishane kakhulu — ukusikwa okulinganisiwe okufushane (okuhlangene, okujwayelekile)
step1_constants.bump_cap_hint: Okuningi okungengezwa umehluko wezindima. Okujwayelekile: 20
step1_constants.civil_term_hint: Okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile: 10 iminyaka · Art. II §9
step1_constants.economy_intro: Umnotho oqala emhlabeni wakho — lokhu kuhamba ezindaweni zegunya ezingezinhlwana njengokwenziwa kwemithetho yomthethosisekelo.
step1_constants.election_interval_hint: Okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile: 60 izinyanga (iminyaka eyi-5) · Art. II §2
step1_constants.emergency_hint: Okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile: 90 izinsuku · Art. II §7
step1_constants.err_game_mode_network: Iphutha lenethiwekhi lapho kulondolozwa indlela yomdlalo.
step1_constants.game_mode_intro: Isilungiselelo somhlaba wonke. Khetha ukuthi lo mhlaba uyawugcina kangakanani umthethosisekelo wawo. Kulondolozwa ngokushesha lapho ukhetha.
step1_constants.game_mode_production_blu: Umhlaba usebenza ngokungqongqo ngaphansi kwemingcele yomthethosisekelo. Yonke indima, izifakazi, nesivimbelo kugcinwa njengoba kubhalwe.
step1_constants.game_mode_sandbox_blurb: Alikho uqiniso lomthethosisekelo — ithuluzi lokuthuthukisa lingathatha noma iyiphi indima futhi lenze izifakazi. Lokhu kungenxa yokubonisa, ukuhlola, nokwakha umhlaba ngaphambi kokuba uqale.
step1_constants.heading: Okujwayelekile Komthethosisekelo Nomnotho
step1_constants.inherit_note: Setha kanye, kufundwa yonke indawo. Konke okujwayelekile komthethosisekelo nomnotho lapha kuqala izilungiselelo zendawo yegunya ngasinye ezingashintshwa futhi kuhamba ezindaweni zegunya ezintsha lapho ziqala — ukuze bangaphindi baqale ukwakha okukhona. Indawo yegunya ngasinye isengashintsha amanani ayo ngokuxhumana nendawo lapho isivimbelo sayo sokusebenza sivuleka. Indlela yomdlalo engaphansi yisici somhlaba wonke, hhayi sendawo yegunya ngasinye.
step1_constants.intro: Umsungula umthethosisekelo nomnotho wawo manje — amanani angaphansi ayala okujwayelekile okuhlongozwe i-Fair Constitution Template ("okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile"), aboniswa njengokubhekisisa. Ungaphuma kuwo lapha. Ngemuva kokusungulwa, noma yikuphi ukushintsha okwengeziwe kumele kuhambe ngezinqumo zesishayamthetho ezisemthethweni.
step1_constants.judicial_term_hint: Okujwayelekile kokujwayelekile: 10 iminyaka · Art. IV §4
step1_constants.max_seats_hint: Okuzenzakalayo: 9 (ngaphambi kokuhlukaniswa okuphoqelekile) · Art. II §2
step1_constants.pay_moderator_hint: Inkokhelo yemisebenzi yomphakathi yabaphathi. Okuzenzakalayo: 5
step1_constants.pay_node_hint: Inkokhelo yemisebenzi yomphakathi yabantu abaqhuba ama-node. Okuzenzakalayo: 8
step1_constants.pay_officer_hint: Inkokhelo yemisebenzi yomphakathi yabaphathi abakhethiwe nabaqashwe. Okuzenzakalayo: 12
step1_constants.residency_hint: Okuzenzakalayo: 30 izinsuku zezinhlamvu ze-GPS ezifanele ngaphambi kokuba ukuhlala kuqinisekiswe futhi amalungelo okuvota/ukuba umkhethwa avulwe.
step1_constants.sizing_law_hint: Isayizi isishayamthetho ihlelwa ngokwemizuzu yabantu, bese ifakwa ku [min, max], bese ihlukaniswa ezifundeni zesayizi [min_seats, max_seats].
step1_constants.special_max_hint: Okuzenzakalayo: 180 izinsuku · Art. II §5 · kumele kube ≥ min.
step1_constants.special_max_label: Ukukhetho Okukhethekile — Izinsuku Ezinye Emva Kwesihlalo Esingenamuntu
step1_constants.special_min_label: Ukukhetho Okukhethekile — Izinsuku Ezincane Emva Kwesihlalo Esingenamuntu
step1_constants.stipend_floor_hint: Wonke umuntu onokuhlala okusebenzayo uthola lokhu. Okuzenzakalayo: 50
step1_constants.supermajority_hint: Isingathekiso sezingathekiso: 2/3 · Art. VII · kumele kube ngaphezulu kuka 1/2 (iningi elilula).
step1_constants.voting_method_hint: Isingathekiso sezingathekiso: STV Droop · Art. II §2 · okwamanje yona kuphela i-algorithm esebenzayo.
step1_constants.worker_parity_hint: Isingathekiso sezingathekiso: 2000 · Art. III §6 · kumele kube ≥ umngcele wesihlalo sokuqala.
step1_constants.worker_parity_label: Umele abasebenzi : Ukulingana kwabasebenzi nabashayeli bemasheya (abasebenzi)
step2_map_data.accept_confirm:
Izimpawu zedatha evulekile zisasele: {critical} okubalulekile, {warning} isixwayiso, {info} ulwazi.

Ukuvuma kuvala isikhathi sokulungisa kulezi zimpawu zisasele. Uyafuna ukuvuma noma kunjalo?
step2_map_data.apply_pending_body: Uqondise uhlelo ku {path}, kodwa ama-container awakaqapheli. Shesha lokhu kufolda lohlelo (lokhu kwakha kabusha ama-container — ukumisa/ukuqala noma ukuqala kabusha akwanele), bese uchofoza u-Re-check:
step2_map_data.apportioning_note: Kuhamba ukwabelana kwe-cube-root kwi-tree yendawo yegunya…
step2_map_data.continue_title_accept: Ukukuvuma kuvala isikhathi sokulungisa, bese kuqala ukuhlelwa kwamanani
step2_map_data.continue_title_load: Landa okukodwa okubalulekile wesizwe (ADM1) ngaphambi kokuqhubeka
step2_map_data.dev_simulate: Dev: simulate idatha ngokusizakala emva kokwakha (sandbox world kuphela)
step2_map_data.dl_protomaps: Ama-tiles emaphu — Protomaps maps.protomaps.com · vector planet basemap for the map background
step2_map_data.dl_worldpop: Abantu — WorldPop data.worldpop.org (CC BY 4.0) · pulls boundaries too (needed to attribute population)
step2_map_data.empty_body: {path} ibhukelwe ku /archive. Ayikabi nayo idatha. Landa ngezansi, noma ubeke amafayela kulelo folda, bese uchofoza u-Re-check. Akudingeki ukuqala kabusha i-container.
step2_map_data.err_choose_dataset: Khetha okukodwa okubalulekile wedatha okufanele kulandwe (imingcele, abantu, noma ama-tiles emaphu).
step2_map_data.err_continue_network: Iphutha lenetwork ngenkathi kuya ekuhlelweni kwezifunda.
step2_map_data.flag_count: isimo somaphu {n} flag{s} — hlola ku-Jurisdiction Viewer →
step2_map_data.folder_saved: Kugcinwe. Phinda usebenze i-docker compose up -d, bese uvuselela le khasi.
step2_map_data.handoff_body: Amafayela wonke alandwe. Ukudonsa kwama-multithreaded kuqala ngesikhathi esilandelayo se-app scheduler, imvamisa phakathi komzuzu owodwa. Kulindwe {wait}.
step2_map_data.handoff_late_note: Ukudluliswa kulinde imizuzu emibili ngaphezulu. I-scheduler container ayikusebenzisi. Kuseva chiza docker compose ps scheduler kanye no docker compose logs --tail 50 scheduler. Uma kuphindaphinda ukuqala kabusha, kusho ukuthi inkumbulo yayo incane kakhulu: vuselela i-app, sebenzisa i-installer futhi, bese wenza docker compose up -d scheduler. Isimaki sokudlulisela sihlala kudisku futhi ukuqala kuqala ngesikhathi sokuphila sokuqala.
step2_map_data.heading: Landa Imingcele + Idatha Yabantu
step2_map_data.intro: Qondisa idatha yomaphu yakho, bese usebenzisa i-ETL pipeline. Inqubo ibonakala ngokuphaphama kusuka ku-ETL container. Uma ukuqala kuphothulwe, hlola noma yikuphi ukungaguquki okufakwe isimaki ngaphambi kokuqhubeka nokuhlelwa kwezifunda.
step2_map_data.live_blurb: Kuthathwa kwemininingwane kubashayeli abasemthethweni ngemigqa efanayo, bese kufakwa. Yonke imigqa ibhalwe injini uqobo — akukho okwenziwe lapha.
step2_map_data.local_folder_help: Uma amafayela emaphu akho ekulutho oluhlukile kule khompyutha, faka leyo folda lapha. Kubhalwe ku ARCHIVE_PATH ku .env yakho ukuze i-container iphinde ixhumanise /archive kuyo. Ku-Windows, sebenzisa indlela yakho ye-host (isib. D:\fair-constitution-map-files).
step2_map_data.map_health_clear: ✓ Impilo yemephu icacile — azikho izifanekiso ezivulekile.
step2_map_data.mode_desc_eager: PREBUILD kuphela: isishayamthetho ngasinye sinosayizi, imephu ngasinye idwebiwe, izikhungo zilungiswe. Abantu abalingisiwe, izinhlangano nemithethosivivinywa kuyinketho ye-Dev ehlukile ngezansi.
step2_map_data.mode_desc_manual: Akukho okuzenzakalayo — Shesha ngokwe-indawo yegunya ohlwini, dweba amaphu, yakha izikhungo ngamafomu azo; emhlabeni we-sandbox yonke imigqa esheshisiwe ithola inkinobho ye-Simulate.
step2_map_data.mode_desc_population: Akukho okwakhiwe ngaphambili — indawo ngayinye iqala ngokuzenzakalayo lapho abahlali abaqinisekisiwe bephuza imingcele yayo (5–9).
step2_map_data.mode_population: Shesha futhi Andise Izikhungo Lapho Abadlali Bejoyina
step2_map_data.mount_not_present: Ukuxhumana kwe-archive {mount} akukho ku-ETL container. Faka ifolda yakho yasendaweni ngezansi (bese uqala kabusha), noma landa idatha emithonjeni esemthethweni.
step2_map_data.no_scope_warning: Ayikho indawo yezwe esethwe — lokhu kulanda ZONKE izwe (umhlaba wonke). Lindela 14 GB+ yedatha yemingcele + yomphakathi kanye namahora okulanda. Ukuze ukunciphise, faka uhlu lwe-ISO3 ku-Run Options ngezansi (isib. NZL,USA).
step2_map_data.protomaps_warning: Qaphela: ukwakha i-Protomaps yomhlaba kunemayelana ne ~100 GB futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukulanda. Yilande kuphela uma ufuna i-basemap yomhlaba wonke.
step2_map_data.pull_engine_blurb: Injini yokudonsa e-multithreaded — iqulu labasebenzi lifaka izwe ngendlela efanayo nokubona okuhamba manje, ukuma/ukuqhubeka, nokufaka kancane kancane. Amaphutha afakeka ukuze abuyezwe; awalimazi uhambo.
step2_map_data.review_body: Ukufakwa kuqedile. Vula umbonisi we-indawo yegunya ukuze uhlole imingcele, abahlali, ama-raster overlays, ubudlelwane be-dual-footprint, nokuhlola impilo yemephu — bese uyamukela idatha yemephu lapho (planet scope). Chofoza Continue ngezansi lapho usukwamukele — lokhu kuqala ukwabelana.
step2_map_data.review_repair_note: Ukukwamukela kuvala isikhathi sokulungisa, ngakho sebenzela noma yini ohlose ukuyilungisa ngaphambi kokuba amukele.
step2_map_data.review_viewer_note: Kuvuleka ethebhu entsha — ukusetha kuhlala lapho kukade kukhona. Amukela ngenkinobho esekhasini laphansi.
step2_map_data.run_mode_aria: Indlela yokusebenza — ukuqala okusha noma ukubuyela esigabeni esiqedile
step2_map_data.source_archive_desc: Faka noma yini etholakele ngenhla endleleni yeqongqo {mount} (emaphathwe kusuka efoldeni yakho ye ARCHIVE_PATH). Indlela esheshayo — ayikho inethiwekhi.
step2_map_data.source_download_desc: Thola idatha evulekile ngqo kusuka ezindaweni zawo ezisemthethweni, bese uyayifaka. Ithola azo zonke izizwe — i-archive yomhlaba wonke efakwa yi-engine enemigqa eminingi yokusebenza.
step2_map_data.source_folder_desc: Faka indlela yeqongqo container ethile — isithombe esihlukile noma isigaba esingaphansi kwe /archive. (Ukuze ukhombe ifolda ehlukile kukhompyutha yakho, sebenzisa "Khombisa ifolda yasendaweni" ngenhla.)
step2_map_data.source_upload_desc: Khuphela i-tarball noma ifolda kusukela kule browser. Isiboneleli sokukhuphela iziqamu eziningi asikaqali.
step2_map_data.tooltip_p1: Izihlolo eziyisikhombisa zilinganisa impilo yemephu efakiwe, ngendlela efanayo nethuluzi lokumapa izifunda elilinganisa ukulingana kwabantu nokubambana kwesimo. Kuphela izihlalo ezingenasisekelo (orphaned rows) okuchaza into efakiwe ephutha.
step2_map_data.tooltip_p2: Okunye kuchaza umhlaba: imingcele ephikisanayo okufanele ibekanye endaweni eyodwa yomdlalo, amaqembu ama-ayisilanedle aphethwe kusuka emhlane okude, umthombo wezesizwe obhala isigodi esisodwa ezingeni elimbili, izwe elingahlanganiswa yi-raster yomhlali. Ukukuvuma kuvamise ukuba yisixazululo esifanele.
step2_map_data.tooltip_p3: Isibalo esikhulu siyajwayeleka ekufakweni komhlaba wonke. Okubalulekile ukuthi isihlolo sesakhiwo sicace — vula isibukeli ufunde incazelo yaso sonke isihlolo.
step3_districts.continue_title_ready: Izifunda zakhiwe. Qhubeka uye esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
step3_districts.continue_title_wait: Ukuqhubeka kuvuleka lapho ukuhamba kwemaphu kuphela
step3_districts.drift_note: {n} amaphu aphothulwe anemihlalo ehluke nalawo abelwe isishayamthetho sawo (isihlalo {net}). Ukuhamba kuyiphutha. Isihloko bahambisela abantwana, ngakho izihlalo zemaphu kumele zihlangane nisinombolo sabo esabelwe. Lawa maphu kumele adwebe kabusha.
step3_districts.err_aborted: Isicelo sokuhamba simiswe ngemva kwe-{s} s. Ukuhlola okulandelayo kuzozama futhi.
step3_districts.halt_confirm: Misa ukuhamba okugcwele? Abasebenzi bayama emngceleni wabo olandelayo; konke okusekhiqizweni kuhlala. Ungaqhubeka noma nini.
step3_districts.heading: Zakha Izifunda Zakho
step3_districts.idle_giants: idle — kusele izinto ezinkulu kuphela (izindawo ezisindayo {running}/{cap} zimatasa)
step3_districts.intro: Ukwamukela idatha yemaphu kuqale ukwakha okugcwele: indawo yegunya ngayinye ithola isishayamthetho esisizeka ngomthetho we-cube-root, futhi isishayamthetho ngasinye sithola imaphu yesifunda yasungula — ukuhlanza kwe-mixed-autoseed kwezindawo zegunya zabavoti, izikhungo ezizimele zabalulekile zamaqela. Ungahamba; ukuhamba kuzilungisa kwalo kuphela kunoma iyiphi inguquko phakathi kwemizuzu futhi leli khasi likulandela buq live.
step3_districts.kill_title_armed: Chofoza futhi ukuze u-kill le lane. Iscope ipaka ekubuyekezweni.
step3_districts.kill_title_idle: Bulala le lane emngceleni wayo olandelayo. Chofoza kabili.
step3_districts.lane_title_base: Isicelo sivulekile ku-{elapsed}. Amber ngemuva kwe-{amber}, ebomvu ngemuva kwe-{red}.
step3_districts.lane_title_red: Ngemuva kwesixwayiso sesibili. Ukubulala kukubeka i-scope ekubuyekizweni.
step3_districts.lane_warn_note: Isixwayiso se-lane: amber ngemuva kwe-{amber}, ebomvu ngemuva kwe-{red}. I-scope ebulaliwe ibekwa ekubuyekizweni.
step3_districts.layer_bar_title: {trivialDone} / {trivialTotal} amamephu esifunda se-at-large · {compDone} / {compTotal} amamephu okuhlukaniswa komvoti · {panelDone} / {panelTotal} amamephu epaneli yomvoti · {lineDone} / {lineTotal} amamephu okuhlukaniswa komugqa
step3_districts.no_root_body: Isinyathelo 1 kumele siqede ukulanda okukodwa okukodwa i-data ye-ADM0 ngaphambi kokuba izifunda zikhunjwe. Buyela esinyathelweni se-data yemephu ukuze uhlole.
step3_districts.phase_done: Kuphelele — yonke indawo yegunya inesishayamthetho nemaphu okungqongqo
step3_districts.phase_mapping_drawing: Isigaba B — ukudweba yonke imaphu yesifunda sokungqongqo (ezilula kuqala, bese kulandela ezinkulu)
step3_districts.phase_mapping_precompute: Isigaba B — amakhonsathi ama-leaf + ukubala geometry kusengaphambili (imingcele ikhokhwa kanye, hhayi izikhathi ezingu-48k)
step3_districts.phase_sizing: Isigaba A — ukunikeza isayizi yesishayamthetho ngasinye (umthetho we-cube-root, True All Scale)
step3_districts.quality_computing: Kubalwa izibalo zomhlaba wonke — zizovela lapha emsebenzi uphele.
step3_districts.rewind_confirm:
Buyisela ukumeleka ekuqaleni?

Lokhu KUCOCOCISA yonke imaphu yesifunda eyenziwe ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kudale imidwebo emitsha yokungqongqo. Isayizi, amabhodi okungqongqo, nokubalwa kwendawo okwenziwe kusengaphambili kugcinwe; imaphu ethenjiwe/yomsebenzi ayithintwa neze. Uhambo luhlala lumiswe — cindezela Qhubeka lapho usulungele.
step3_districts.rewind_title: Susa imaphu eyenziwe futhi udale imidwebo emitsha yokungqongqo (isayizi + ukubalwa kusengaphambili kugcinwe)
step3_districts.row_sub_floor: Phansi kwezinga (izihlalo ezi-{max} kuya kwezi-2 ngamunye):
step3_districts.sizing_pass: Ukuhlola usayizi — izishayamthetho ezingumzali (kuqinisekisa kabusha wonke umzali)
step3_districts.tip_a_compactness: Ikala ukuthi imingcele yangaphandle yesifunda ihlangene noma ingajwayelekile usebenzisa i-Convex Hull Ratio: indawo yesifunda ihlukaniswa ngendawo ye-convex hull yaso (1.0 = ihlangene ngokuphelele).
step3_districts.tip_a_constituentless: Izindawo zegunya ezingenabo abavoti. Phakathi kwebande lezihlalo, indawo yegunya enjalo iyisifunda esisodwa esingakhethiwa ngokukhethekile; phezu kophahla, ihlukaniswa yi-leaf ladder, lapho izinsika zayo zizamela ngokulandelana (umugqa wokuhlukanisa omfushane, ibhokisi, ama-community cells, ama-vertical strips, ama-horizontal strips, izinto zonke) kuze kube yilapho eyodwa ifayila. Imigqa ibiza insika efayile kumephu yesi; ama-maphu "angabhaliwe" adwebiwe ngaphambi kokuba izikhathi ze-ladder zigcinwe.
step3_districts.tip_a_contiguity: Ukuxhumana kuthathwa njengokwaphukile kuphela lapho kwakungaba khona ekuqaleni. Izinto ezingenzeki ngokwegGeography azifakiwe. Lokhu kufaka izindawo zegunya zezilanda ezingenalo ibhodi lomhlaba elithinta omunye, amalungu azungezwe ngokuphelele izindawo zegunya ezinkulu kakhulu ukuba zihlanganiswe ngaphandle kokwephula uphahla lomthethosisekelo, kanye nezifunda zelungu elilodwa, ezingalokhu zingaphambani nomthethosisekelo.
step3_districts.tip_a_diversity: Kuyo yonke indawo ehlangene, izibalo zezihlalo zesifunda ezidwebiwe ziqhathaniswa ne-Optimal ekukhombisayo ukubuka kwemephu: ukuhlukaniswa okulinganayo kwezihlalo zakhelwe indawo ngokwesincumo se-Droop threshold esiphansi kakhulu (ukuhlukahluka kwezombusazwe okulinganayo), okukufanele kwendawo yegunya eyodwa okubalwe njengenye eceleni kwayo. I-Optimal kusho ukuthi zombili ziyafana; I-Not optimal kusho ukuthi ukudweba kuhlukile, okuhlanganisa wonke amanye amaphutha abhalwe phansi.
step3_districts.tip_a_equality: Ikala ukuthi ukulingana kwanani labantu ngesihlalo kuyo yonke isifunda kuhambisana kangakanani nomgomo we- "umuntu oyedwa, ivoti elilodwa". Ukuhlukana okuphansi kusho ukuthi ivoti ngalinye linesisindo esilinganayo. Kuhlanganisa zonke izifunda ezihlanganisiwe emhlabeni; izifunda ezizimele ezinye azinawo ukuhlukana ngenxa yokwakhiwa kwazo.
step3_districts.tip_a_integrity: Kuhlulwa ngama-maphu ahlangene kuphela (izindawo zegunya ezinabo abavoti). Izifunda ezidwebiwe ngokwemingcele yokuphatha esikhona zigcina imiphakathi ihlangene; ingxenye ehlukanisiwe ivele phakathi kwemephu ehlangene kuphela lapho umvoti ephethe izihlalo ezingaphezulu kophahla ovumelekile futhi engenazo izinhlukumezo zakhe. Ama-Leaf maps aneminyaka yawo ngezansi.
step3_districts.tip_a_legality: Imephu yesifunda ngabe ihlala ngokugcwele isibalo sayo esabelwe (akukho ukushintsha), igcine isifunda ngasinye phakathi kwebande lezihlalo ezi-5–9, futhi ibhale noma yisiphi isimo esiphansi (Art. II §2) noma isimo sophahla (ukufika okuphelelwe kwezihlalo ezi-1 noma 0 okukhuliselwa ku-2 ngezihlalo zebonasi) lapho i-geography iphoqa lokhu.
step3_districts.tip_b_contiguity: Iphaneli ihlangene lapho izindawo zegunya ezakha yona zenza ingxenye eyodwa exhunywe yomngcele we-chamber. Ukwaphuka kuphoqeleka lapho iphaneli isabalala ezilandeni noma ezindaweni zomhlaba ezihlukile ezingathinti omunye. Ukwaphuka okusele kuyinxenye yokuhlukaniswa okulinganayo: I-Clumping Spread iza ngaphambi kwe-Contiguity, ngakho lapho kungekho ukuhlukaniswa okulinganayo okuhlangene, umvoti ujoyina iphaneli eseduze kakhulu nge-centroid.
step3_districts.tip_b_diversity: Landela ukuthi ama-clumps anezibalo ezinganani zezingxenye zabavoti. Ngokuba nezihlalo ezilinganayo ngaphaneli, izibalo zamalungu ezilinganayo zinikeza ukumela okulinganayo. I-Spread iwuhluku phakathi kwephaneli enkulu nesincane kakhulu kumephu: 0 kusho ukuthi iphaneli ngayinye inesibalo esifanayo, 1 kusho ukuthi "zilingana ngaphandle kweyodwa", noma yini engaphezu kuka-1 ayilingani.
step3_districts.tip_b_legality: Imephu yephaneli ayikwazi ukuhlala ngaphezu kophahla lwe-Type B (isibalo se-Type A, esibekelwe isilinganiso ukuze izihlalo zingaphumeli kubantu), kumele ibeke yonke indawo yegunya ephaneli eyodwa kuphela, kumele kube gena iphaneli engenamuntu, futhi izihlalo zephaneli zayo kumele zihlangane zibe yizihlalo ze-Type B ze-chamber. I-chamber whose ladder already fits igcina iphaneli eyodwa ngomvoti; i-chamber whose ceiling holds less than one panel ngokomthetho ayihlali nakulutho.
step3_districts.wb_complete: Isigaba 2 siphelele. Ukwamukela idatha yemephu kuqala ukudweba manje.
step4_scale_up.building_worklist: Kwakhiwa uhlu lomsebenzi: {seeded} / {total} zezishayamthetho ezibhaliswe (kungaqhubeka, phezulu-ngezansi ngokwezigaba)
step4_scale_up.heading: Khulisa Izikhungo
step4_scale_up.intro: Isishayamthetho ngasinye sithola izikhungo zaso. Isethi yeshelu ifika kuqala ngama-batch: isigungu esiphethe, inkantolo, ibhodi lokukhetho, isikwebe nemizi yomphakathi, kanye nezikhulu zezimali zomphakathi. Ngemva kwalokho, umugqa owodwa ngesishayamthetho uhlela ukukhetho kwaso kokuqala nemincintiswano yaso, futhi ubhalise amakomiti neminyango njengezinqumo zesistimu. Misa, qhubeka, noma ubuyisele noma nini. Ukuqhubeka kushiya imiphumela.
step4_scale_up.layer_title: {seated} sekusungulwe · {shelled} senamashelu (silindele izihlalo) · {review} ukubuyekeza · {pending} kulindelekile · {skipped} kushiwe (umthetho kawu-zero)
step4_scale_up.maps_running: Amaphephu ezifunda asasekelwa. Isinyathelo 4 siqala lapho ukuhamba kwamaphephu kuphela.
step4_scale_up.notice_halt: Kucelwe ukumisa. Imigqa iyama emngceleni wayo olandelayo; ipompo iqoqa okusele phakathi kwemizuzu emibili.
step4_scale_up.notice_started: Ukuhamba kuqale. Uhlu lomsebenzi luqala kuqala; imigqa iyalandela.
step4_scale_up.rollback_confirm_acts: Buyisela emuva izihlalo nezinqumo (ukhetho, amakomiti, iminyango, izikhuluma zemali ezingenamali). Amashell ayahlala.
step4_scale_up.rollback_confirm_shells: Buyisela emuva IZIKHUNGU ezakhiwe yilokhu kuhamba: izihlalo, izinqumo, izikhuluma zemali namashell ezikhungo. Amaphephu, izifunda, amaphanele nadatha yendawo ayithintwa. Uhlu lomsebenzi lubuyela ekuqaleni.
step4_scale_up.rollback_confirm_suffix: Ukuhamba kumele kumiswe noma kuphele. Qhubeka?
step4_scale_up.timing_note: Ibhala yingxenye yomigqa ngomzuzu. Buka Phakathi kwezifiso: umgqa olalayo ngumgqa ongasebenzi.
step4_scale_up.timing_sub: lapho isikhathi sihamba khona · isilinganiso ngengxenye, isizinda kuzo zonke izindlela
step5_simulate.aspect_civic_life: Impilo yomphakathi (izinhlangano, Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, amabhodi)

step5_simulate.force_finish_title: Bhala izindawo ezingaxazululeki eminingwaneni yokuqedela bese uqeda
step5_simulate.heading: Lingisa
step5_simulate.intro: Isinyathelo 4 sakha izikhungo. Isinyathelo 5 sizigcwalisa: abahlali banqume ngokwendawo, abantu badalwa, ukhetho lwasungulo lwenzeka lwabala ngomshini wangempela, abamele bahlala ezihlalweni, amakamra akhula, inkantolo ihlala ezihlalweni, nokuziphatha komphakathi kulingiswa. Isigaba ngasinye sisebenzisa amafomu omthethosisekelo, akukho shortcut. Misa, qhubeka noma ubuyisele emuva noma nini. Qhubeka kuvimbela imiphumela.
step5_simulate.lock_title_review: Xazulula izindawo ezingaxazululeki, noma uqede ngokubala okukhishiwe okubhaliwe
step5_simulate.notice_halt: Kucelwe ukumisa. Imigqa ima emda wazo olandelayo wesimo; qhubeka kusuka lapho kwamise khona.
step5_simulate.notice_resumed: Kuqhubekile. Ipampu ibuyisela abasebenzi phakathi nomzuzu.
step5_simulate.notice_resuming: Kuqhubeka ukugijima okungaphelelanga — kubalwa kabusha ngokuhle.
step5_simulate.notice_started: Ukugijima kuqale. Uhlu lomsebenzi lubalwa kuqala; imigqa ilandela phakathi nomzuzu.
step5_simulate.readiness_pending: ukuqinisekisa kulindile — shaya ukuskena kokwamukela ngaphambi kokukhiya
step5_simulate.rollback_confirm:
Buyisela emuva lokugijima kwale SIMULATION: sula uhlu lomsebenzi nemigqa yayo ukuze ukugijima okusha kubale kabusha. Umhlaba osewuvelisile (amaqoqo, abantu, izihlalo, irekhodi lomphakathi) USALELA LAPHO, kanti izikhungo zeSinyathelo 4 namamephu wonke awathintiki.

Ukugijima kumele kume noma kuphele. Qhubeka?
step5_simulate.scope_sub: · khetha okufanele kusimulathwe — izinto ezidingekayo zizohambisana ngokuzenzakalela, ngakho akukho okudingekayo okungashiya ngaphandle. Abantu nezikhwama zimali zigijima njalo.
step5_simulate.timing_note: Ibhala yingxenye yomugqa ngomzuzu wonke. Bheka Phakathi kwezifiso: umugqa ohleli ngokulinda ngumugqa ongasebenzi. Qhathanisa isilinganiso sesigaba ngaphambi nangemva kokushintsha ukuze ubone ukuthi usheshe noma uhamba kancane.
step5_simulate.timing_sub: lapho isikhathi siya khona · isilinganiso ngengxenye, isizinda kuzo zonke imigqa
step5_simulate.verify_pending_note: Ukuhamba kuphelile kodwa ukuskena kokwamukela akuzange kwenzeke. Kunemingcele futhi kungaqhubeka — shesha isigaba sokuhlola, bese ukhiya. Lesi simo asikwazi ukuphushwa.
step6_confirm.closed_body: I-instance isethulwe. Izishayamthetho zinobukhulu, izifunda zikhiwe, izikhungo zikhona. Siyakwamukela kumthethosisekelo wakho owonakele.
step6_confirm.finish_point_1: Ukuqinisekisa nesithombe sezinga ledatha kurekhodiwe kuzilungiselelo ze-instance.
step6_confirm.finish_point_2: I-setup_completed_at isethwe. I-/setup ikusa ekhaya kusukela lapho.
step6_confirm.finish_point_3: Akukho okunye okuqhubekayo. Izikhungo bezinyathelo zeNyathelo 4; isimulashini yiNyathelo 5.
step6_confirm.heading: Qinisekisa & Vala
step6_confirm.intro: Bheka isimo se-instance, bese uvala ukusetha. Kusukela lapha umhlahlandlela uphelile: izinto ezizinzile nendlela yomdlalo kuyakhiywa, futhi umhlaba uyavuleka.
step6_confirm.legislatures_note: Kukhona eyodwa ngendawo yegunya, inobukhulu ngokomthetho we-cube-root.
